mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing insulin’s effects on muscle and liver was most worthwhile: the planned pictures distinguish transporter insertion in muscle from glycogen storage and reduced glucose output in liver.

leastWorthwhile.text: The between-meal branch was predictable and had only one combination available at each decision, although it completed the comparison.

surprise.text: The liver picture explicitly distinguishes its glucose entry from the muscle-style transporter insertion, rather than presenting insulin’s effects as identical in both tissues.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the combinations followed the two stated conditions, though the last two were the only available combinations.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter if it offered similarly clear comparisons, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the final single-option sequence.
